text:
Handbook slice for this step: role develop, class code, risk tier normal (docs/design/handbook.md). A higher layer wins over a lower one; a lower layer may only be stricter.

## 1. Constitution (owner: operator)
- System's constitution binds every change: its invariants (docs/architecture/invariants.md in the System repository) and its accepted ADRs (docs/decisions/adr/README.md); the decision rules are docs/decisions/README.md#decision-rules. Read the ones a change bears on.

## 2. Organisation policy (owner: operator (the lead proposes))
- This change is normal by the policy's path map (ADR-0071): one review, then the steps after it and the checks the policy requires.

## 3. Project charter (owner: operator, with the lead)
- Objective (project system): System runs software work end to end.
- Criteria: c1: accepted results land on dev.

## 4. Role playbook (owner: lead)
- Your role's playbook (develop) is this step's instructions, as template algorithm-development words them; it is not repeated here.
- Your role's rules, each one line; its home and its check: docs/design/handbook.md#layer-4-role-playbooks
- W2 change only what the task needs; the smallest coherent change
- W3 never weaken, skip, or loosen a test or benchmark
